trips.route_note: Take an express train from Bengaluru City Junction to Mysuru Junction, about 2.5 to 3 hours, then an auto or taxi to the palace; buses also run but take longer.
trips.why: The bus is the fastest listed option at 2h 45m, versus 3h by train, and it avoids the last-mile trip from the station to the palace.
know: Mysore Palace is the main draw; the palace is illuminated on Sunday evenings and on some public holidays.
Cooler months, roughly October to March, are the most comfortable for sightseeing.
Frequency per day is not confirmed here, so check timetables before you set off.
